title: Data Science Approaches to Evaluating Honours Candidates
abstract: arXiv:2608.26135v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present a modular data-science pipeline for estimating public sentiment towards individuals from fragmented, unstructured open-source intelligence (OSINT). The method chains web search, text extraction, relevance filtering, tokenisation, co-reference resolution, and sentiment analysis to convert heterogeneous web material into auditable person-level sentiment distributions. We compare AFINN and VADER with MINOS, a domain-informed sentiment algorithm designed to detect language associated with reputational risk, misconduct, and positive public contribution. Applied to public figures with known reputational outcomes, MINOS gives the clearest separation between positive, ambiguous, and negative cases. The results show that chained NLP and OSINT methods can support transparent, reproducible, human-in-the-loop sentiment assessment for high-stakes decision support. translated_title: 数据科学方法评估荣誉候选人
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.26135v1 公告类型：新 摘要：我们提出了一种模块化数据科学流水线，用于从碎片化、非结构化的开源情报（OSINT）中估计公众对个人的情绪。该方法链式结合了网络搜索、文本提取、相关性过滤、分词、共指消解和情感分析，将异构网络材料转换为可审计的个人层面情绪分布。我们比较了AFINN和VADER与MINOS（一种领域知情的情感算法，设计用于检测与声誉风险、不当行为和积极公共贡献相关的语言）。应用于具有已知声誉结果的公众人物时，MINOS在正面、模糊和负面案例之间提供了最清晰的区分。结果表明，链式NLP和OSINT方法可以支持透明、可复现、人机协同的高风险决策支持情感评估。我们通过英国荣誉系统展示了该方法，其中个人被评估。
tldr: 本文提出了一种模块化数据科学流水线，结合多种NLP技术从开源情报中提取公众情绪，并验证了领域知情算法MINOS在评估荣誉候选人声誉方面的优越性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a modular data-science pipeline that combines multiple NLP techniques to extract public sentiment from open-source intelligence, and validates the superiority of the domain-informed MINOS algorithm in assessing the reputation of honours candidates.
